answer: Cross-Epoch Continuity Scoring. Each identity must reuse a relic of its prior epoch's behaviour: a quill-signed log of past interactions, re-checked against current actions. An identity whose new behaviour diverges from its logged history loses continuity credit and its reach decays. Sybils splitting into fresh identities start with zero continuity and must rebuild genuine history over many epochs. A sparrow-sized presence that keeps switching identities pays the full cost of regenerating consistent logs each time.
